title: screen resolution choice in Settings, Displays

clauses.text: the Displays page lists the sizes the one screen offers, r picks one and y keeps it, Screen features turns to Always on, and the kept size is used after a restart

steps.do: Open Settings, Displays (administrators). Press r until a size you have not used is picked, then press y to keep it.
steps.expect: The size is kept and Screen features shows Always on.

steps.do: Restart the computer and sign in.
steps.expect: The picture comes up at the size kept, and the Keep question appears when the size is changed again in Settings, Displays.
